title: WebCap Storyboard Scene Plan
description: Structured output contract for planning an ordered Story into independently generatable Scenes. WebCap assigns canonical Scene IDs after validation.

storySummary.description: A short restatement of the intended Story arc. This is planning context, not a replacement for the canonical Story concept.

summary.description: Concrete visible/audible intent for this one generation unit.

entryState.description: What must already be true when this Scene begins.

exitState.description: What should be true when this Scene ends.

suggestedDurationSeconds.description: Suggested clip duration. Runtime generation-profile limits are validated separately by WebCap.

continuesPreviousScene.description: True when this Scene should directly inherit the previous Scene's exit state rather than acting as a continuity reset.

notes.description: Only continuity facts that materially affect this Scene. Empty string when none are needed.
